utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, did you say you could help gather supplies this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, is it this Saturday? I thought it was Sunday, but I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's definitely Saturday, Oren. Can you make it, or are you going to be tied up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Hana, I've been picking up bits from Vik and Rosa about the repair drive—do you know what the full plan is?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it's this Saturday at the front porch. I'm rounding up folks to help fix things like toasters and such. Would you be able to join?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Saturday at the front porch? That sounds doable. I can be there—just tell me what to bring!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: You're right, Kira. Maybe we should pause and make sure we have everything squared away before we go any further.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're saying we need to see a sign-up sheet before we move forward? I'm glad you agree.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely, let's get a sign-up sheet and check with the HOA first. I don't want us to get in over our heads.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just to clarify, the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch anymore.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh thanks Opal, I was still thinking it was Saturday by the porch. Guess I'm a bit behind again.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries, Dane! Just make sure to mark your calendar for Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm so sorry for the confusion—Rosa just let me know the repair drive was moved to Sunday at the community center. Can you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Moved to Sunday? That changes everything. I'll update my calendar and let the others know at the next street meeting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli—I really appreciate you helping spread the word. Let me know if you need any flyers or details for the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! So glad you're here — I was just telling Vik and Faye about the repair drive this Saturday, and I think the Andersons are bringing their blender. Think you could lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'd be happy to help with the blender or anything else that needs fixing. Just tell me what you need!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great, Sam! We could really use someone good with electronics — maybe you can take a look at Noah's toaster too while you're at it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Noah! It's this Saturday—bring your toaster, we'll get it working!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Saturday? I thought it was next month... but sure, I'll drag the toaster over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: And don't forget, it's at the community center on Elm Street—I'll text you the exact address right now!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, a blender? So it's not about the car at all?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The car's done, but I'm taking it further. Repair drive this Saturday, front porch. Need helpers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive! I can probably drop by for a bit on Saturday. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'm so glad Sunday works for you, Cleo! It'll be wonderful to have your toolbox and expertise there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, I'll be there with my tools and ready to help out!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, I'll put you down for the repair team then!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Mara, have you heard? That repair drive is this weekend—they'll help us fix anything from creaky bikes to broken toasters!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Tess! It's on Saturday at my front porch. I could use an extra pair of hands if you're free to help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I'd love to help! Count me in—I can bring some spare tools and my famous lemonade to keep everyone hydrated.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Uli, I already told Kira about it—the repair drive's this weekend for fixing up old tools and electronics, not a car. The Andersons are bringing their broken blender!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, that's good. A blender? Maybe I'll finally bring in that old radio of mine.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, bring that radio! Bo mentioned it's at the garage on Maple, but it's actually at the community center. Want me to remind you later?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Ira, I heard you're working on the repair drive. How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I'm not working on it, just heard it got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Sunday at the community center? That's different. Do you know why they changed it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Ira! You know about that repair drive coming up? I'm thinking of bringing in my old blender that's been acting up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Tess, I just heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sunday? No kidding! Thanks for the heads-up, Ira—I almost showed up tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good of you to ask. It's going... it's keeping my hands busy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Uli, just a heads-up—I've got it down that the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at your front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Sunday at the community center. I'll adjust my plans. Thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Eli, just wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What? Moved to Sunday at the community center? I had everything planned for Saturday on the porch—tools, sign-up sheet, coffee ready. That's a big change.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I know it's a hassle, Eli, and I'm sorry for the late change—the community center offered us more space and better shelter in case of rain.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I've been hearing bits and pieces about this repair drive from everyone—sounds like a great way to meet folks and maybe finally get that old toaster looked at.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, bring that toaster along! Bo's bringing one too—we'll have a whole corner for small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a whole toaster corner? That's perfect—maybe we can compare notes on how to get them working again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, the one at the garage on Maple. I think it's for anything small, like my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, right, the repair drive at Maple Garage. I heard it's for old electronics and small appliances, not just toasters though. You should bring anything that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good to know, I'll bring my blender too then. Thanks, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey, Quinn! I'm so glad I ran into you — do you know if the repair drive is this Saturday or Sunday? I keep forgetting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's this Saturday, Oren! I've been telling everyone—Tess is stoked about fixing up old bikes, and Cleo's bringing a whole box of tools. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, got it! Thanks, Quinn. I'll be there—maybe I can bring that broken lamp I've been meaning to fix.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh Gus, I hope you heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, Rosa just filled me in. Sunday at the community center—I'll make sure to bring my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, glad you're on board! Don't forget to label your tools so they don't get mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm ready to pitch in wherever needed, just let me know what tools or supplies you think we'll need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe we can start by checking the old generator; I've got a wrench if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rey. I'll grab my tool kit and meet you by the generator.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh Leo, actually the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center now—can you still help out?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Wait, moved to Sunday? I can still help, but I'll need to rearrange my schedule. Can you confirm the time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's Sunday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center—thanks for being flexible, Leo!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, you're right about the repair drive—it's for old tools and electronics, not a car. The Andersons are bringing their broken blender!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, a blender too. Do you know if they're coming in the morning or afternoon? I want to make sure we have enough workspace set up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think they mentioned morning, but let me confirm with them later.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, you're right... I'm not really sure where I heard about it. Maybe I mixed it up with something else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: See, this is exactly what I was worried about. We can't just go around acting on rumors—has anyone actually confirmed this with the building management?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: You know, I think my neighbor mentioned something about it while I was half-listening... but now I'm questioning if that was even real.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, are you free to lend a hand at the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, you bet I am! And I've already roped in Hana to help spread the word, and Noah's toaster might finally get fixed too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, that's a relief—so we've got you, Hana, and maybe Gus too. Should I add you to the supply run list?
